title: No Death for Bees
description: Prevents bees from dying after stinging.
body:
# 🐝 Never watch your bees suffer again 🐝


**🐝 A simple datapack that prevents bees from dying after stinging 🐝**

---

### Installation 🐝

Download the datapack.
Place the .zip file in your world's datapacks folder.
Run /reload or restart the server.

Your bees can now sting without dying.


Supported Minecraft versions: 🐝 1.21 – 26.1.2 🐝

🐝
